ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by one-month forward discount and hold a long basket of high-interest-rate currencies against a short basket of low-interest-rate currencies.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Currencies against the US dollar; the paper reports a developed-country sample as well as a broader sample.
rules.entry: At month-end, sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount. Go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
rules.exit: Rebalance at the end of each month.
rules.filters: Include currencies with spot and forward rates available in the current and subsequent period; the paper also reports a developed-country sample.

ideas.claimed_result: For the broader sample, the paper reports annualized average log excess returns of −2.33% for the lowest-interest-rate portfolio and 6.20% for the highest, before transaction costs.

report.work_done: Ran the requested searches and opened the cited paper.
report.open_questions: Availability of historical forward rates and bid-ask spreads was not verified.
